annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is framed as a branded news and commentary segment about the Pegasus spyware case and related public-affairs allegations. The narration presents a news update about a forthcoming Supreme Court hearing and asks who was spied on, so the spyware references function as reporting and political commentary rather than a viewer-directed transaction or data request. Apparent transcription errors and unverified allegations do not change the described reporting context.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is investigative and critical discussion of alleged spyware use and surveillance, including reported legal proceedings and questions about who was targeted.
